brief.t: The new deals pipeline is live in the CRM and I verified it this morning. Ten open deals worth one point three seven million dollars, staged hot, warm, and new, with stale flags. I start plugging in the missing deals today.
Valeva is still showing overdue from Tuesday with a backlog of seven orders. Confirm it shipped or tell me what is blocking. This is item one.
Ben Kar proposal is a day overdue. I am drafting the full proposal this morning. You review and send it once, then we stop chasing and his silence is his problem.

Plot twist on Dan Gonyea. He emailed yesterday in writing, copying his whole team, asking for fifty thousand unit pricing on Unshrinkit before placing the order. Flake or not, that is an order forming. Decide today: quote him or officially pass.
Victor Armendarez confirmed specs, both SKUs turnkey, Edge Gel in the six ounce jar. His numbers are due tomorrow. I am building the cost breakdown today, you just review and send.

WhatsApp needs attention. Halene asked if their order lands by Friday. Ashley at Earth and Ash is disputing whether Miron glass bottles were included in her quote, eight unread messages. And AloeTallow asked if we are fulfilling first thing this morning.
Developer scorecard: production blank screen fix verified and closed. Formula upload fix deployed but stays open until Evelyn's next real upload proves it. Laura's lockout ticket still open.

next: One lane: confirm Valeva shipped, or unblock it. Nothing else first.
Then review and fire the Ben Kar proposal I draft this morning.
Then decide on Dan Gonyea's fifty thousand unit Unshrinkit request.
I handle Victor's numbers, the pipeline board population, and WhatsApp triage.

kb.a: Kyle at AloeTallow asked overnight whether we are fulfilling first thing this morning. Confirm with Booky that fulfillment is moving.

Payroll is due today in Gusto for the June 15 to 28 period. Austen your bookkeeper is out on his honeymoon until July 15th and did not reconcile June yet. He pre-set payroll but you need to log in and confirm it actually runs. Five minutes.

The landlord, Denise Cook, flagged high priority: Guardian Sealcoat is doing asphalt work in the parking lot at 24600 North Industrial today. Make sure it doesn't block the Valeva trucks or the facility move. Read her email and reply.

Ben Kar of Tavro, roughly thirty thousand units custom tallow and argan oil, ninety percent close but silent since June thirtieth and never received a proposal. The agent is drafting the full proposal today. Sam sends it once by email and WhatsApp, then we stop chasing.

Victor Armendarez, eighty seven percent close, two thousand units per SKU of Curl Defining Cream and Edge Gel, both turnkey in six ounce jars. He confirmed specs by email. Cost breakdown and sixty five percent margin pricing due Friday July tenth. The agent is building the numbers, Sam reviews and sends.

Elmar Nasibov, three products at 65 percent margin. This is now unblocked. Ronald sent full formulation and costing overnight, not just raw ingredients. I'm computing the all-in cost and your firm sell price per unit for the Mist, Serum, and Cream today.

Oreka quote Q zero zero zero seven is accepted and Sam confirmed full payment of eighty five hundred fifty five dollars. Pending: log the payment, open the production job for one thousand peptide creams, delete the orphan formula, and pay Nikkie's commission.

Kristen Reed, new lead, about ten thousand dollar intro, baby-safe skin barrier spray. Laura's intro call happened yesterday and she accepted. I'm creating the CRM task for Laura to deliver the scope and R&D quote, high priority.

Tiffany, hot lead, leaving for Africa. She wants to talk this week before she flies, and she's got sixty four hundred TikTok videos and marketing running. Give me a time slot and I'll lock the call on WhatsApp today.

Kenna gatekeeps everything Pure Good, including quote Q-0028, roughly 329 thousand dollars. Aidan has a task due July 8th for her Cleanser and Hair Mask prices, ten thousand units each. She also sent an updated formula for Roon overnight. If she stalls on pricing, that's your relationship to push.

Kenna expanded Terra Lotus: thirty thousand units of face cleanser in tubes plus shampoo, conditioner, and body wash samples. Aidan's quote task due today does not include the cleanser yet, Sam needs to approve the update. Evelyn's sample task went overdue July 7.
Aidan owes three quotes today: Atlas for Kenna, Pure Good pricing, and Terra Lotus. HALENE is also waiting on bakuchiol shipment tracking from him. Being monitored, escalation tonight if they slip.

Ronald delivered the full Elmar costing overnight. Still open on his desk: the jojoba substitute, the Smoke Oak and Iron Pine fragrances, and the dish detergent question. Maqui Berry is parked waiting on the client, not stalled.

Raul at STRUCK, existing client, happy. Two open items: he owes the HRIPT submission form from Rania at SS Analytics, and Evelyn owes him both COA documents. I'm confirming Evelyn sent them and following up with Raul.

Laura is handling One Time Bargain bottles and trademark photos, Petit Nuage's NDA which is now signed, and the ASSEA NDA details. Her CRM lockout fix is a fresh sign out and sign in, awaiting her confirmation.

Four tickets. Production blank screen: fixed and verified, closed. Formula first save upload: fix deployed, open until Evelyn's next real upload proves it. Laura's pipeline lockout: still open. Raw materials pricing in quotes: confirmed and closed.

Six high-value leads have gone silent twenty five to forty plus days: Phoebe at eighty percent, Chantell seventy eight, Amy Saylor seventy eight and five thousand units, Sarah Dale, Ambrose, and Veronica. That's thirty to eighty thousand in idle pipeline. I'm drafting re-engagement emails for you to approve in a batch.
The Ryan Fiore EPHIX call was Wednesday at noon. Also, the law firm emailed asking whether to proceed with filing the certificate of assumed name for EPHIX. Sam or Aidan needs to reply.
Sky and Sol, sample already went out, client's back from vacation Friday July 11th. Your CRM task is due Thursday the 10th. Follow up Friday morning, nothing to do before then. I'll remind you.

James Bailey, Morning Glory pricing, you left a voicemail, no reply. One thousand MOQ at eight seventy four, five thousand around six dollars against his four to five target. If no reply by end of day July 9th I'm flagging it back to you.

Loutra, two duplicate quotes for the Mason Depoy Cleanser, both eighty four hundred one dollars, one day apart. I'm identifying the live one and sending the developer a ticket to delete the duplicate.

Kyle at Aloe Tallow is about to refund a stuck order. USPS tracking never scanned and his inventory question went unanswered twice. Today's first move: message Kyle and Booky, confirm the scan, inventory arrival, and Valeva status.
Atlas Skin, Kenna's lead, thirty four thousand three hundred, quote Q-2005. That's your lane, direct relationship. No movement by end of week and I'm flagging it.
New facility, lease closed, move is imminent, and asphalt work is happening at the building today. Move checklist is on my desk to draft, you'll review before anything goes live.
Sam, you shared your Gmail password in chat and there are already new sign-in alerts. Rotate it today, that's not optional. Two minutes.

ASSEA needs chemist shipping guidance for refrigerated samples, the NDA which Laura is preparing from Apostolia's details, and HS code documents which Aiden is reviewing. She also asked whether year old fridge samples are worth sending for comparison testing, Ronald to answer.
Le Petit Nuage, Kristina Manukyan from Ohio, signed the NDA yesterday. Discovery call happened Tuesday. Laura is point. New client in early stage.
Aran Beauty wants four scent samples: vanilla, jasmine, rose, and sweet orange. Ronald is being asked for feasibility and timing, then the client gets an update on WhatsApp.

Dan Gonyea at fifty two launch emailed July eighth asking for fifty thousand unit tiered pricing on Unshrinkit before placing an order, with his whole team copied. Sam previously called him a quote shopper. Decision needed today: quote him or officially pass.

The new deals pipeline is live and verified. Ten open deals worth about one point three seven million dollars across New Lead, Warm Lead, Hot Lead, Quoted, Closed Won and Closed Lost, with stale flags and a deals tab on every customer. The agent is populating missing deals like Victor, Ben Kar, Terra Lotus and Elmar today.
Halene, the bakuchiol skincare client, asked on WhatsApp whether their order lands by Friday. Needs a straight answer today, check with Aidan on tracking.

Ashley English at Earth and Ash is disputing her quote on WhatsApp, eight unread messages. She believes Miron glass bottles and closures were included in the agreed price. Someone needs to pull the quote document and clarify before this turns into an angry customer.
Mina Elias of Trivium booked a thirty minute call with Sam for Wednesday July twenty ninth at two thirty eastern.
